about: One drawing of the dense topic map, made in a browser at 1408 by 803 px from the document below, by the renderer dense.js was taken from: every name it placed and dropped, every text width it measured, and the density grid of one zone. The document is a cut of a public conversation's stored map, with each topic named by a language model. The widths were measured in the drawing's own faces; here those faces are called reference-sans and reference-mono, the families the test passes as settings.

expected.caption: Drawn now at 1408 by 803 px: 69 topic names (layer 3 (5 zones): 5 of 5; layer 2: 14 of 14; layer 0: 50 of 124). Shrunk to fit: 8. Moved off their centroid: median 0.3, 90th percentile 3.0 font heights.
